title: Conditional κ = 0.000751075693834608: weighted gen5b matching with second descent
body:
The `research/gen5b-weighted-matching/` package rebuilds compensated reuse **after producer endpoint descent**, choosing donors by their actual final-frame rank. It composes that word with all PR299 kernels and PR300's second scalar descent, followed by freshly screened early restorations and terminal sinks.

**Conditional κ = 46942230864663 / 62500000000000000 = 0.000751075693834608.**

This is **0.00249968% above this PR's previous weighted-matching checkpoint** (`03acc26f9624ce15c4149f927b7b9aeb0de301b8`) and **0.156885% above independently reproduced PR299 at `5f6bd3fbc0e6796dd31263cef1f06dc968186f64`** (`0.000749899215319498`).

This is the reproducible weighted-matching checkpoint that later contributions build on. [PR307](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/307) explicitly reuses this weighted virtual word and producer while re-deriving stronger kernel selections; [PR308](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/308) carries those selections through additional reorder stages. Subsequent proposals now advertise higher bounds. The contribution here is the donor-rank matching method, its scoped proof, portable producer, and independently replayed composition. The incorporated PR300 second-descent transformation remains pinned to `fd516176fd068e4fa7af14b40cd878ce8c305296`.

The exact post-descent graph has 65,920 eligible donor edges. Rebuilding matching admits **1,728 reuse pairs instead of 1,726**, and donor-rank weighting chooses **878 rank-21 donors instead of 706**. For each fixed exponent between zero and one, higher donor rank increases the donor-only splice benefit. A transversal-matroid argument supports the weighted rule on this fixed graph; Hopcroft-Karp independently checks maximum cardinality. This does not assert optimality over producer frames, module designs, later transforms or the full finite construction.

| Quantity | PR299 | This package |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Reuse pairs | 1726 | 1728 |
| Final independent dirty registers | 15427 | 15425 |
| Literal stock, 60 replicas | 1229750 | 1229735 |
| Kernel entries | 1720 | 1720 |
| Early restorations | 440 | 440 |
| Terminal sinks | 7 | 7 |

All 904 initial scalar retimings and 220 target groups are rebound to the weighted word. All 1,720 kernel entries are mapped through logical roles and rechecked. PR300's **89 post-kernel retimings** are bound by logical role, identical scalar occurrence census and exact old-frame basis. Its unchanged native descent transformer checks spans, paths, both reflected ledgers, endpoints, COPY lifetimes and scalar projection; its unchanged `rebind_descent2` charges the entire delta. Restorations and sinks are freshly screened afterwards.

The second descent adds 65 local paid calls (93,539 → 93,604), with unchanged rank mass, 721,418 scalar ADD events and 724,938 unit ADD events. Its full additional cost is retained. The complete invoice includes 913 endpoint charts, conservative normalizer 815, 905,876,840,400 selector calls, primitive coefficient **90,322,316,339,049,601**, and a 98-bit signed payload bound. Cleanup and arbitrary dirty old-value return remain paid. Both exact moment engines, all 47 outer constraints and adjacent-grid exclusion are recomputed.

All eighteen inherited mathematical/checker cores listed in `SECOND-DESCENT-PROVENANCE.json` remain unchanged from the preceding public checkpoint. `SOURCE.json` records original PR299 differences and the pinned PR300 contribution. The final physical word SHA-256 is `6a723cdd5285a7b2085d3f612af3f2fc6e7e997ba943243aac936e0ff4735a3e`; package manifest is `a74e82e07777be4df1dc47a8b646029a30641027c9e0c1764e45d774b26630d9`.

Reproduction requires Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0 and new output directories:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/gen5b-weighted-matching/requirements.txt
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/verify.py \
  --output /tmp/gen5b-weighted-verification
python -B research/gen5b-weighted-matching/gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py \
  --work /tmp/gen5b-weighted-regeneration
```

The verifier freshly executes all twelve stages, rejects pin-recording mode, runs retained mutation and omitted-stage controls, and rechecks every source hash at completion. A new control invokes the unchanged restoration transformer on the actual pre-second-descent word and requires rejection at its input-word hash guard. The producer command rebuilds all five pinned virtual files from module data, endpoint descent and weighted matching, with all local F2 and defining-integer-decoder columns checked. Gzip members are compared after decompression. The producer and its five outputs are unchanged from the previous fully verified checkpoint. Neither command consumes cached PASS receipts.

The latest update only clarifies documentation: `MATCHING-PROOF.md` explicitly labels the `03acc26` bound as historical and links the current second-descent result. Its manifest entry is updated. All other 155 package inputs, including every numerical input, selection and checker, are unchanged from the independently verified scientific checkpoint `10b40041d4ab8a6610083e95bc571aee3468bca2`. Historical provenance and replay receipts are preserved.

Current signed head: `8268f385147549636f085b8a6d3422a268286c46`. Native package integrity passes all 156 input hashes. All four fork workflows completed successfully on this exact head, **59/59 jobs passed**:

- [Weighted matching](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039688): both complete twelve-stage replays, on Python 3.11 and 3.13, and full five-file producer regeneration passed (3/3).
- [Full repository research and formal suite](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039675): 52/52, including joint-dual checks on all three Python versions.
- [Terminal elimination](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039713): 2/2.
- [Recycled registers](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38096039588): 2/2.

GitHub reports the PR open, ready for review and mergeable. 8 upstream workflow runs still require maintainer approval (`action_required`); these are separate from the successful fork runs.

The branch also integrates upstream `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`. The sole merge conflict was `.gitattributes`; both sets of exact-byte preservation rules are retained. Follow-up `7163446` refreshes the historical joint-dual bindings for the reviewed upstream root `Makefile` and `README.md` and regenerates only the dependent certificate/validation hashes. Complete native `make verify-joint` passed, including both producer words, exact profiles, 47 constraints, seven margins, all 16 regression controls and the independent arithmetic audit. Every numerical and proof field remains unchanged. All 56 fork CI jobs on that preceding maintenance head passed.

Independent local replay of the scientific package completed all twelve stages in 261.80 seconds. Fresh imported-checkpoint verification also passed: all nine gen4 stages and all eight source527 stages. Previous Linux runs reproduced all five weighted producer files. Current-head CI is reported separately above.

The inherited all-size compiler, common chart, restored-row, selector, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-correctness and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. This is a conditional finite construction, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a new Lean proof or a practical runtime benchmark.

Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including Ody's matching/composition research and coordinated independent integration/review. Compensated reuse itself and the other mechanisms are inherited. Credits include Chafik Boukhalfa (PR299/296 and the supplier chain), DreamingOfClouds' modules and producers, Rohan Arun's retiming and second descent (PR300/291, Anthropic Claude assistance), Eumemic's source527 lineage, Dugongue's kernels/banking/sinks, utcorvusvolat-dotcom's restorations, and the full retained contributor chain. Original PR299 and PR300 notices and licenses are preserved. Earlier PR275 packages remain reproducible historical checkpoints; this package supplies the PR's current strongest result.
